native_read_bytes: At least one full native load per frame; implementation/cache dependent, not measured yet
per_frame_memory_lifetime: Load one original TDR, measure, release plot then dataset, verify original hash after release
operation_payload: original file SHA256 and lstat identities
time_estimate_policy: Use actual original TDR size and separately measured hashing/native integration throughput. No guaranteed 3D extrapolation from 2D timing.
storage_policy: Reserve original solver outputs and full solver archive separately. Only duplicate postprocess TDR payload is removed; no existing evidence is deleted.
timeout_policy: Unknown or interrupted native operation is reconciled read-only before any further submission; no automatic retry.
